scope.purpose: Choose one value from a long list of options by typing to narrow it.
useCases: A country or a city among hundreds.
A person or a project, filtered locally.
Options searched on a server (filter none, options updated from inputChange).
exclusions: Free text as a value (creatable options) in v1.
Inline autocompletion of the typed text.
Loading indicator inside the panel in v1 (the application can show it next to the field).
alternatives: Select for a short list without search.

fixtures: Phosphor glyphs re-exported by examples/icon/glyphs.ts for the leading icon example.
A country list fixture in examples for long lists.

checks.name: npm run validate (schema, consistency, token coverage in 18 contexts, dependencies)
npm run build:tokens (coverage and contrast evidence)

decisionsTaken: Same trigger look as InputText and the same panel, option and group children as Select, so that the two read as one family.
Strict value: the value is always one of the options; free text is restored to the selected label when focus leaves; emptying the input and leaving clears the value.
Filtering: filter contains (label contains the text, case and accent insensitive, original order) or none (the application filters, for a server search).
Typing highlights the first enabled match so that Enter chooses it (WAI-ARIA list autocomplete with automatic selection of the highlight, not of the value).
Keyboard per the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern: focus stays in the input, the highlighted option is the active descendant; Home, End and horizontal arrows edit the text; no wrapping; Alt+Down opens.
Empty state: emptyLabel (default "No results") shown in the panel and announced politely; English default strings as for Dialog closeLabel and Alert dismissLabel.
nextAction: Wave 4 contract gate: present the contract to the user and record the approval.
implementationNotes: Bits UI Combobox likely reused for roles only, or replaced by an own primitive on the native popover (decided at implementation).

informational.reason: Same trigger colors as InputText (color.input.*): its exemption accepted at the wave 2 contract gate (2026-10-26, "4 ok") applies; color.input.default.border reaches 2.06 on surface.muted in dark, a de-emphasized backdrop where forms are not expected.
